title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00025 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:45: Removed well cap on f-12. Installed lower riser joint and WL BOP
01:45 - 03:45: Connect WL control lines and hoses to BOP. Function tested BOP rigged up kill hose to tree p/u upper WL riser joint lifted WL equipment to rig floor
03:45 - 04:00: Performed pre-job meeting w/ new crew
04:00 - 04:30: Installed upper riser joint on top of BOP meanwhile continued to open rig BOP for inspection
04:30 - 04:45: Changed BX inserts to 3. 5in meanwhile continued to open rig BOP for inspection
04:45 - 07:45: Continued to r/u WL equipment above RKB meanwhile continued to inspect and clean rig BOP. M/u WL lubricator on HTS and installed hoses on same. Filled a and b annulus.
07:45 - 08:00: Lifted lubricator from HTS to TDS
08:00 - 08:30: Built cable head and tested same meanwhile worked on flow line and cleaned BOP from cement
08:30 - 08:45: Performed pre-job meeting to p/u tool string w/ deep set plug BHA
08:45 - 10:00: M/u tool string, installed kill hose onto the tree
10:00 - 10:15: Performed pre-job meeting to fill and pressure test WL rig up
10:15 - 11:00: Flushed lines w/ 50/50 MEG. Filled WL riser and lubricator
11:00 - 11:45: Pressure tested WL rig up to 20/345bar for 5/10min
11:45 - 12:00: Performed pre-job meeting to bullhead the well
12:00 - 12:30: Opened MV and HMV. Observed pressure inside tree increased to 55 bar. Applied 520 bar on control lines for DHSV. Performed line test and open KWV. Pumped 3 m3 50/50 MEG/SW with cement unit 1100l/min 83bar
12:30 - 12:45: Pumped 10m3 wash pill at 1300l/min 91bar
12:45 - 15:00: Bullheaded well with sea water at 1300l/min, 90 bar. After pumped 40m3, standpipe pressure started to increase slowly. Final circulation pressure 151bar
15:00 - 15:15: Pumped 10m3 MEG/SW with cement unit at 1100l/min siwhp when stopped pumping 55bar
15:15 - 17:45: Equalized and opened SV. RIH with WL to 3010m.
17:45 - 19:30: Correlated depth w/ BHA Correlation interval 2850m-3005m
19:30 - 20:30: Trouble shoot winch after

sections.text: Removed well cap on f-12. Installed lower riser joint and WL BOP
Connect WL control lines and hoses to BOP. Function tested BOP rigged up kill hose to tree p/u upper WL riser joint lifted WL equipment to rig floor
Performed pre-job meeting w/ new crew
Installed upper riser joint on top of BOP meanwhile continued to open rig BOP for inspection
Changed BX inserts to 3. 5in meanwhile continued to open rig BOP for inspection
Continued to r/u WL equipment above RKB meanwhile continued to inspect and clean rig BOP. M/u WL lubricator on HTS and installed hoses on same. Filled a and b annulus.
Lifted lubricator from HTS to TDS
Built cable head and tested same meanwhile worked on flow line and cleaned BOP from cement
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u tool string w/ deep set plug BHA
M/u tool string, installed kill hose onto the tree
Performed pre-job meeting to fill and pressure test WL rig up
Flushed lines w/ 50/50 MEG. Filled WL riser and lubricator
Pressure tested WL rig up to 20/345bar for 5/10min
Performed pre-job meeting to bullhead the well

Opened MV and HMV. Observed pressure inside tree increased to 55 bar. Applied 520 bar on control lines for DHSV. Performed line test and open KWV. Pumped 3 m3 50/50 MEG/SW with cement unit 1100l/min 83bar
Pumped 10m3 wash pill at 1300l/min 91bar
Bullheaded well with sea water at 1300l/min, 90 bar. After pumped 40m3, standpipe pressure started to increase slowly. Final circulation pressure 151bar
Pumped 10m3 MEG/SW with cement unit at 1100l/min siwhp when stopped pumping 55bar
Equalized and opened SV. RIH with WL to 3010m.
Correlated depth w/ BHA Correlation interval 2850m-3005m
Trouble shoot winch after not able to achieve stable running speed with winch. Suspected overheating of hydraulic system
Set plug w/ mid packer element at 3003 m. Confirmed plug set w/ tagging
POOH from 3003 m to surface. Average pulling speed 22m/min meanwhile performed TBT for pressure testing of plug
Closed SV and inflow tested same meanwhile lined up cement unit for pressure test plug
